primitives.name: High-Risk Transaction Restriction
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not launch paid contests, prizes, deposits, payouts, live leaderboards, sportsbook/DFS affiliate flows, or real-money entries without founder/legal approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'Legal risk level (high/medium/low)', 'A': 'Action type (paid contest, prize, deposit, etc.)'}
primitives.assumptions: Any A ∈ {paid contest, prize, deposit} implies L = high unless approved.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If L = high and A ∉ approved_set, action blocked.

layer2.mapping: Legal risk L is derived from action type A and approval state.

primitives.name: Fake Data Enforcement Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not import real friend-history data without explicit consent and deletion controls.
primitives.assumptions: F = real requires C = true and D = enabled.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If F = real and ¬(C ∧ D), data import denied.

layer2.mapping: Data fidelity F is determined by consent C and deletion D.
